content:
Overview

Pamplona is a city in Navarre with a population of 202,000. Famous for the Running of the Bulls, with a beautiful old town, strong Basque-Navarrese culture, and excellent quality of life. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
